implementation.name: JTBLKOUT
implementation.notes: Source availability (T5.4): open -- the HDL lives in the jotego/jtcores monorepo at cores/blkout/, 4 source files. There is no open_source column in the delivered schema (data-model.md §1.9 deleted the proposed core table together with its flags); the presence of hdl_language_id, license_id and implementation_path rows is how that fact is stated here. License: https://github.com/jotego/jtcores/blob/master/LICENSE is the verbatim GPLv3 text, and the per-file grant in https://github.com/jotego/jtcores/blob/master/cores/blkout/hdl/jtblkout_fb.v reads "either version 3 of the License, or (at your option) any later version" -- hence GPL-3.0-or-later. Machines unmapped: jotego/jtbin publishes no MRA file naming <rbf>jtblkout</rbf>, so there is no setname to join on. The core's HDL is public but no released ROM recipe identifies which MAME sets it runs. hdl_language_id: 4 of 4 HDL files are verilog (4 verilog), excluding the shared framework directory. accuracy_id omitted: jotego's README claims faithfulness in prose but states no timing-fidelity level this build could check against data/lookup/accuracy_level.json.
